run_binaural_evaluation: run the evaluate script to binauralize test sequences and compute l2, amplitude, and phase error metrics
run_chunked_forwarding: run chunked forwarding to binauralize a mono audio signal using a trained binaural network
run_compute_metrics: run compute metrics to calculate l2, amplitude, and phase error between predicted and reference binaural signals
review_chunked_forwarding: review the chunked forwarding function that processes audio in 10-second chunks with receptive field overlap
review_compute_metrics: review the compute metrics function that evaluates binaural audio quality using l2, amplitude, and phase loss
